description.zh:
要设置静态页面缓存的域名。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which you want to configure the Static Page Caching policy.

> You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.

description.zh:
设置静态页面缓存的开关状态。取值：

- **1**：表示开启。
- **0**：表示关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the Static Page Caching policy for a website. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the policy.
*   **0**: disables the policy.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 设置网站业务静态页面缓存的开关状态

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于设置网站业务静态页面缓存的开关状态。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the ModifyWebCacheSwitch operation to enable or disable the Static Page Caching policy for a website.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-cache-switch --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --enable 1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
